reply.keys: exactly presets; any other key or type refuses the reply
reply.presets: at most 16 entries, each exactly id, max_output_tokens, model and operations, ids unique
reply.max_output_tokens: integer 1..32768: the longest reply the preset allows
reply.model: a model name as the broker accepts one: 1..256 printable ASCII characters, no space, nothing shaped like a provider key
reply.operations: the built-in operations the preset permits, no repeats, from the closed list chat, threads, sessions, streaming, compaction, proposals, memory_read, memory_propose; a name outside the list refuses the whole reply
reply.source: the harness's compiled presets (guest/src/presets.rs): Chat permits every operation except proposals and memory_propose, Build permits all of them

refresh: on load, on request, and every 60 seconds while the page is visible; a read that is superseded is ignored

screen.presets: one card per preset: its model, its longest reply, and all eight built-in operations, each marked Allowed or Not allowed in words as well as colour
screen.chat_and_build: a card that says what the two modes are and that a preset only selects among operations already in the node: it never loads code, runs a command or opens a network connection
screen.unavailable: the preset cards are replaced by one card with the shared icon and short service state without a code; a failed read removes the last good list

states.initial: heading, purpose, one Presets card reading CHECKING, and the Chat and Build card
states.loading: the same, until the first read settles
states.empty: one Presets card reading NONE: the node reports no presets
states.ready: a Chat card and a Build card
states.refusal: one Presets card shows the shared short refusal state without the service code; only a confirmed ended session asks for sign-in
states.service-unavailable: one Presets card shows a muted icon and Not yet; malformed replies remain refusals
states.phone: operation rows wrap so the state sits under the words at 480 px and below

face_holds: preset names, a model name, a number and a closed list of operation names; it cannot create, copy, edit or delete a preset, and a preset carries no code
